FFmpeg third-party notice

This plugin invokes the unmodified standalone FFmpeg/FFprobe executables.
The JavaScript plugin uses a subprocess and does not link against FFmpeg.
FFmpeg copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers.
Build: n8.1.3-18-g46d899d7a0-20261020, Windows x86_64 LGPL shared.
Provider: BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, autobuild-2026-10-20-13-08.

Original binary archive:
https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-10-20-13-08/ffmpeg-n8.1.3-18-g46d899d7a0-win64-lgpl-shared-8.1.zip
Original archive SHA256:
453a30a5019676e805a85d4845e3aad31234dfed4ae0ea2b1d4e97254dc44b0a

FFmpeg source snapshot included: source/ffmpeg-source.tar.gz
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/46d899d7a0
Build system and dependency source locations included:
source/ffmpeg-build-scripts.tar.gz
https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/tree/63ac326
The scripts.d directory in that archive lists the third-party components,
their upstream sources, build flags, and patches. Those dependency source
repositories are separate from the included FFmpeg source snapshot.

License text: LICENSE.txt (LGPLv3), COPYING.GPLv3 (incorporated terms),
COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and LICENSE.md (upstream component licensing details).
See the source files and build scripts for copyright notices of individual
components. The shared libraries in bin/ can be replaced with compatible
modified versions; no plugin runtime signature check prevents replacement.
To rebuild, follow the included build system README using win64, lgpl-shared,
and the 8.1 addin. Reproducing the exact upstream binary also requires its
toolchain and the upstream component revisions used by that build.

No warranty is provided by this plugin or by the upstream developers.
Keep these notices and source materials when redistributing this package.
